tasks.title: Change title to Christian's Calculator
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Update the app title from 'Mini Calculator' to 'Christian's Calculator' in both the HTML page title and the visible h1 heading. 2. READ FIRST: Read src/App.tsx (contains the h1 heading on line 31) and index.html (contains the tag on line 7). 3. FILES: Modify src/App.tsx — change the <h1>Mini Calculator</h1> to <h1>Christian's Calculator</h1>. Modify index.html — change <title>Mini Calculator to Christian's Calculator. No new files needed. 4. APPROACH: Simple text substitution in two files. No logic changes. 5. PATTERNS: No pattern reference needed — straightforward text change.
